description: This file defines a class RegistryPropertyReflectionExtension that extends PHPStan's properties reflection to provide custom handling for certain properties of the Registry class in an OpenCart-based project. It manages property types and presence based on predefined mappings and naming conventions.

classes.name: Tools\PHPStan\RegistryPropertyReflectionExtension
classes.description: A class that extends PHPStan's property reflection to provide custom property type resolution for the Registry class in OpenCart.

methods.name: hasProperty
methods.description: Checks if the Registry class has a specified property, either default or matching 'controller_' or 'model_' naming pattern.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns a PropertyReflection object for the given property name, inferring its type based on predefined defaults or naming conventions.

methods.name: convertSnakeToStudly
methods.description: Converts snake_case strings to StudlyCase format, replacing underscores with spaces and capitalizing words.
